# Avid - Part A
# The function to play notes and let them last longer.
# pitch tells us which notes to play. beats tells us how long to hold.
# If leave out beats, it uses 1 beat.
def pedalNote(pitch, beats=1):
    # Work out when to stop holding this note
    note_end = getPlayhead() + beats
    # Work out how much longer the note should last until the next bar starts
    # % gives the remainder. If the note ends exactly at a bar line, extra is 0
    extra = (-note_end) % 4
    # Play the notes and let them last for a little longer
    # The extra duration does not make the next note start later
    playNote(pitch, beats=beats, sustain=extra)
